components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA used on marketing pages and key flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2B6CB0; color: #F7F8FA; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid rgba(43,108,176,0.18); outline-offset: 2px; }
